title: Turkey cut-up at a robust and safe level
summary: JBT Marel’s ACM-T automated turkey cut-up system has been upgraded with an enhanced housing, improving the robustness and safety and allowing for visual checks.
body_markdown:
#### Mesh fencing for visual checks


As before, the ACM‑T provides virtually unlimited layout options and production flexibility, delivering high‑yield, A‑grade cuts tailored to specific market requirements. No matter which or how many cutting modules are installed in the ACM-T, the entire system is now enclosed with mesh fencing. This design allows for visual inspection of the module settings. An operator can check from outside the fencing whether, for example, the stepless height adjustment of the front half cutter or the drum-thigh cutter requires correction. If necessary, doors in the fence can be opened to fine-tune a module for the specific flock of turkeys passing through the ACM-T at that moment.
